```{=typst}
#let mk(n) = box(baseline: 22%, circle(radius: 5.8pt, fill: rgb("#d9480f"), stroke: none, inset: 0pt)[#set align(center + horizon); #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8pt)[#n]])
#let tick = box(baseline: 12%, width: 10pt, height: 10pt, stroke: 0.9pt + luma(70), radius: 2pt)
#let shot(path, w: 100%) = block(breakable: false, stroke: 0.8pt + luma(150), radius: 6pt, clip: true, image(path, width: w))
#let typebox(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#f1f6fd"), stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 5pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 9pt), body)
#let tip(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#fff4e6"), stroke: (left: 3pt + rgb("#d9480f")), inset: (x: 10pt, y: 7pt), radius: 3pt, body)
// One step: the box to tick, its number and what to do on the left; its screen on the right.
#let step(n, body, img: none, w: 100%, left: 40%, after: none) = block(breakable: false, above: 9pt, below: 9pt, width: 100%)[
  #set par(justify: false, leading: 0.62em)
  #let words = grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 6pt, [#tick #h(1pt) *#n.*], body)
  #if img == none { words } else {
    grid(columns: (left, 1fr), column-gutter: 12pt, align: (top, top), words, align(center, shot(img, w: w)))
  }
  #if after != none { v(4pt); after }
]
```

::: {.lead}
Today you make a shop list in **Excel** on the lab computer: three items, their prices, quantities and totals. Do the tasks in order. The **orange
numbers** in each picture show where to click. Tick the box `#tick`{=typst} after each step. Stuck? Raise your hand.
:::

- **You need:** a lab computer with Excel. **Nothing to download:**
  you type the text yourself.
- **Time:** about 35 minutes. Your Excel may look a little different:
  the names of the buttons are the same.

## Task 1 · Open Excel and type the list

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *Search* on the taskbar #mk(1). Type *excel*. Click *Excel* #mk(2).], img: "images/lab-open-1.png", w: 80%, left: 32%)
#step(2, [Click *Blank workbook* #mk(1).], img: "images/lab-open-2.png", w: 36%, left: 32%)
#step(3, [Click *A1*. Type the list. Press *Tab* to go to the next cell, and *Enter* at the end of a row:], after: [#v(2pt) #align(center, table(columns: (2.6cm, 1.8cm, 1.8cm, 1.8cm), inset: 5pt, stroke: 0.6pt + luma(90), fill: none, [*Item*], [*Price*], [*Qty*], [*Total*], [Pens], [2], [10], [], [Notebooks], [3], [5], [], [Bags], [7], [2], []))])
```

## Task 2 · A formula

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *D2* #mk(1). Type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[=B2*C2] and press *Enter*. \ D2 shows *20*. The formula bar shows the formula #mk(2).], img: "images/lab-formula-1.png", w: 100%, left: 40%)
#step(2, [Click *B2*. Type *3* and press *Enter*. \ Look at D2: it changes by itself to *30*. Then type *2* again in B2.])
```

## Task 3 · Copy the formula down

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *D2*. Double-click the small square at its corner #mk(1): the *fill handle*. \ D3 and D4 get their totals #mk(2). \ Click *D3*: the formula is *=B3\*C3*.], img: "images/lab-fill-1.png", w: 100%, left: 36%)
```

## Task 4 · The total and the biggest

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *A5* and type *Total*. Click *A6* and type *Biggest*.])
#step(2, [Click *D5* #mk(1). On the *Home* tab, click *AutoSum* #mk(2). Press *Enter*. \ D5 shows *49*: *=SUM(D2:D4)*.], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-sum-1.png", w: 90%)))
#step(3, [Click *D6*. Type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[=MAX(D2:D4)] and press *Enter*: the biggest total, *20*.])
```

## Task 5 · Save your sheet

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Press *F12* (on a laptop: *Fn + F12*). The *Save As* window opens. \ _Or:_ click *File*, *Save As*, *Browse*.])
#step(2, [Click *Desktop* #mk(1). \ In *File name*, type *shop-* and your first name #mk(2). \ Click *Save* #mk(3).], img: "images/lab-save-1.png", w: 94%, left: 32%)
```
